translations.en:
A demon that severs the bonds
between people. One theory holds
that it favors the passion and
similar feelings generated
when people exchange thoughts.

By consuming that passion,
it erases the trust between
adventurers and isolates
them. If feelings such
as "I can't trust my
companions" or "No one
trusts me" suddenly arise,
remember this demon.

translations.en:
A giant serpent that has
learned to devour vitality
as well as flesh and bone.

Even if its massive body's
attacks are avoided, being
caught in its coils allows
it to consume the victim's
life force. Underestimating
it as a mere animal monster
can easily end a life. However,
it is still an animal, and
can be dealt with if its
movements are restrained.

translations.en:
An undead mantis-like insect
that sought to preserve its
species in the struggle for
survival deep in the labyrinth
by abandoning life itself
and becoming undead.

In truth, however, it is not
completely undead, so the
same methods used against
insect monsters will suffice.

translations.en:
Thought to be a special kind
of dragon that appeared suddenly
within the sealed labyrinth.
Though called a special kind
here, whether it should be
recognized as a distinct
species remains open to debate.

Its attacks, body, and place
in the ecosystem closely
resemble those of the common
Fire Dragon, but its power
appears considerably greater.

translations.en:
Suspected to be a Dragonfly subspecies
that lost the struggle for survival
in an enclosed space, then
transformed into an undead
creature through resentment alone.

Its true nature remains unknown,
and further research is needed.
Although reports currently give
it the same power as a Dragonfly,
adventurers should beware the
changes in its attributes
caused by becoming undead.

translations.en:
A wild wolf transformed by
a powerful curse. Despite
the name Cerberus, it merely
resembles that being, and
its power falls far short.

However, it has survived deep
within the labyrinth, and
carelessness can lead to a
catastrophe that decides life
or death. Perhaps its habit
of fleeing stronger enemies
instead of facing them is a
remnant of its wolfish nature.

translations.en:
An ice elemental in the
shape of a dinosaur.

As its appearance suggests,
its intelligence is low and
it acts on instinct. This
makes it aggressive, an
elemental that embodies nature's
mercilessness. Nevertheless,
if its elemental nature is
understood, it can hardly be
called a formidable enemy.

translations.en:
A bronze statue wandering in
search of something lost. It
may have forgotten even what
that lost thing was. Nevertheless,
the desire to find it seems
to sustain the statue as
it roams the labyrinth.

Its existence appears to be
rooted in sorcery, making spells
less effective against it.

translations.en:
A large monster
classed among the
fairies, like a troll.

Ferocious by nature, it
attacks with an enormous
club. It is more agile than
a troll. Let its huge body
deceive you into reacting
too late, and everything
may end before you can
do anything at all.

translations.en:
A special subspecies of the
lamia, which has existed since
the age of Dragoon civilization.

It is thought to have
changed into this form after
absorbing the malice sealed
within the labyrinth over
many long years. It converts
that absorbed malice
into strength, making it
a far greater threat
than an ordinary lamia.

translations.en:
Counted among the
vampire subspecies,
Sophia is unusual in
preferring to consume
human mental energy
rather than drink blood.

Some individuals that have
continually drained magical power
also come to wield spells of
corresponding strength, making
them extremely troublesome
monsters. They also tend to
travel in groups, so do not forget
to prepare for group combat.

translations.en:
Among Ninja, those with
particularly exceptional
talents and techniques traditionally
take the title Hayate.

This is the worst possible
result: one who held that
title transformed into a
demon. Whether the
transformation was desired
or caused by a demon's
deception remains uncertain.
What is certain is that a
supreme assassin has also
acquired demonic power.

translations.en:
A fallen Musashi, bearer of
the highest Samurai title. Or
perhaps a being that has
surpassed even that pinnacle.

It is difficult to believe that
one who attained ultimate truth
would succumb to demonic
temptation, so deception by a
demon is another possibility.
All that is known for certain
is that this is a monster
adventurers must never encounter
in a labyrinth. Yet if they
do meet it, even escape
will likely be difficult.

translations.en:
Among Iron Golems are
some made of gold by
creators wishing to
flaunt their wealth.

This golem habitually
collects Gold, apparently
using it to replace missing
parts of its own body.
Because its material is
gold, its defense is lower
than that of other golems.

translations.en:
A giant that continued to exist
in deep darkness by gathering the
light of hope. Exposed to malice
yet never losing that gathered
light, it survived in the labyrinth.
It is said to have become capable
of glimpsing the truth of
dimensions without ever leaving.

No one, however, has confirmed
what that truth contains. The
sight of its mysterious form
floating in the darkness certainly
makes one want to believe...

translations.en:
Vampires, the pinnacle of
the undead, possess a
distinctive culture whose
ideas are stranger than we
can imagine. Perhaps this
Vampire Queen also came
to Shiin's Labyrinth with
some peculiar philosophy
in mind. Rather than merely
treating humans and
animals as prey, she seems
to approach us with
some special intention.

translations.en:
A transformed Vampire Queen that
used the malice filling the
labyrinth to vastly surpass her
original power. It is also
noteworthy that this transformation
changed her into a demon.

Perhaps intoxicated by that
power, she has even been seen
boasting before adventurers. It
could be said that she acquired
power intoxicating even to
one who once stood at the
summit of the undead. Perhaps
that is why she displays strength
beyond all common sense.
translations.note: Meaning review: this describes the Queen becoming intoxicated by her newly acquired power, not the power defeating another being.

translations.en:
A monster renowned as an undead
spirit that travels through
the endless flow of time.
Thought to have once been a
famous noble or mage, it shows
no trace of human behavior.
Its appearance certainly
suits a resident of this
mist-shrouded city. It is not
a particularly formidable
enemy worth worrying about.

translations.en:
Thought to be a monster
that lurks in darkness
and survives on the corpses
decaying there. In reality,
however, its prey apparently
includes not only corpses
but also the living.
Some have been confirmed
to prefer paralyzing
their victims before
feeding on them.

translations.en:
A lycanthrope that
transforms into an
enormous animal.

Highly intelligent, it skillfully
uses weapons even in beastfolk
form. There are also reports of it
casting spells. An enemy possessing
both physical strength and
intelligence is dangerous indeed.

translations.en:
At first glance, it resembles
an enormous chicken and
looks quite comical. Its
appearance is the only joke,
however; there is not a
trace of humor in its
ferocious nature. Many
adventurers have become works
of art after its swift strikes
and petrifying attacks.

Reported as both a demon and
a dragon, though some
controversy has arisen over
whether it is actually either.

Reports say it uses its wings
for attacks as well as movement.
Adventurers should not trust
assumptions about its attacks
based only on its appearance.

translations.en:
Ordinarily, this would be
a plain crow, not something
classified as a monster.

However, perhaps because of
the city's curse, it is
exceptionally vicious. Still,
however fierce it may be,
it is only a bird. Anyone
unable to deal with an
opponent of this caliber
should reconsider their
fitness to be an adventurer.

translations.en:
A large bear that wandered
into the labyrinth and became
vicious. Territorial by nature,
it works with others in its
group to deal with intruders.
It has not actually transformed
into a monster, but its
powerful body deserves to
be treated as one. Novice
adventurers should be
particularly wary of it.

translations.en:
Normally found near water,
it is rarely encountered by
adventurers who make their
living exploring labyrinths.
However, it appears to be
expanding its habitat through
underground waterways.

Treat it as no more than a
lizard, and it will retaliate
brutally. Its tough tail and hide
require caution; it is better
thought of as a small dragon.
